package.name: core_task_gazebo
package.description:
Gazebo simulation assets for the Omokai core task: the AWS RoboMaker small warehouse world with a TurtleBot3 Waffle Pi, used as the facility for the prompt -> LLM -> mission JSON -> executor -> sim patrol pipeline.
Warehouse world, models and maps are derived from AWS RoboMaker (aws-robomaker-small-warehouse-world), Apache 2.0. See LICENSE.
